what_it_does: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate that sells engineering, procurement, construction, manufacturing, technology services, financial services, and real estate development to diverse industries and retail customers globally, generating revenue through project execution, product sales, services, and lending operations.
other_facts: L&T Technology Services operates in more than 25 countries with over 23,800 employees and partners with 69 Fortune 500 companies.
L&T Finance serves a customer franchise of over 2.8 crore customers across India.
Infrastructure segment secured orders worth 1,99,064 crore in FY 2025-26.
